The kernel prefers enabling fbc over the initial fb

column2: so if the initial fb is deemed too big
then we simply skip allocating stolen for it.

column1: However if the kernel is not configured with fbcon then it should be

column2: since unlike with fbcon the display server

column1: shouldn't preserve it when later replacing it
column2: and so we should be able

column1: to re-use the stolen memory for fbc and friends. This patch is reported
to fix some flicker seen during boot splash on some devices.
